name: Governed Implementation Intent Generation Foundation
objective: Establish the authoritative GENERATE production boundary that converts an approved architecture-grounded RiverDevImplementationPlan and repository development context into a deterministic validated RiverDevImplementationIntent through an explicit bounded content-generation provider, without expanding specification governance, writing repository files, approving proposals, creating execution authority, committing, pushing, or performing network access.
commitMessage: GENERATE-001: Build governed implementation intent generation foundation

generationContract.providerResponsibility: Return candidate content only for explicitly requested approved-scope paths.
generationContract.governanceResponsibility: Select approved generation targets from the authoritative plan, provide architecture-grounded context, reject out-of-scope or excluded operations, assemble deterministic intent metadata and operation ordering, and validate the final intent before returning it.
generationContract.mutationBoundary: Generation returns an in-memory intent only and performs no repository writes.
generationContract.approvalBoundary: Generated intent does not approve any implementation proposal or execution.
generationContract.executionBoundary: Generated intent creates no execution authority.

acceptanceCriteria: A production generate-intent command exists and consumes the authoritative persisted implementation plan rather than reconstructing specification governance.
Generation uses real RiverDev development context for architecture grounding.
Generation targets are bounded to paths already approved by the authoritative implementation plan.
A bounded provider interface can author candidate file content without receiving authority to mutate the repository.
The final RiverDevImplementationIntent is validated by the existing implementation-intent governance contract.
Generated operations are deterministic in ordering and identity for identical plan, context, provider output, and generation timestamp inputs.
Out-of-scope paths, excluded paths, duplicate paths, empty operations, and invalid overwrite semantics are rejected.
Generation performs no repository writes, proposal approval, manifest generation, execution, commit, push, or network activity.
Existing proposal-generator, manifest-generator, artifact-pipeline, and execution lifecycle remain downstream and are not replaced or weakened.
Historical manually authored implementation-intent artifacts remain compatible.
approvalBoundaries: Any expansion beyond approved plan paths requires a new or amended authoritative specification.
Repository mutation remains outside GENERATE and requires the existing governed execution lifecycle.
Proposal approval remains explicit and outside GENERATE.
Commit and push remain explicit user-controlled boundaries.
